Case IDs are stable. Add new IDs; do not renumber existing entries. Assertion IDs identify one assertion site, which may execute across a parameter matrix.
SVG-ready cases have explicit route, settings, landmark and expected-result variants. Geometry checks measure actual native output against the current rules.
